# JSON audit → SIEM

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P1 · Who did it](../README.md#phase-1--who-did-it) · **Lane:** Integrations · **Label:** `feature:audit-log-export` · **Epic:** [#65](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/65) · **Tickets:** 4 (3S 1M)

Each worker can emit a dedicated structured JSON decision stream, one line per mediation, to stdout or a rotating file, including user identity fields. A SIEM shipper (Vector, Fluent Bit, Splunk UF) can tail the stream without parsing operational logs. The schema is versioned and documented, and it never contains bodies, headers or secret values.

## How we build it

- New package `internal/auditlog` with `Store`, an `analytics.AnalyticsStore` decorator in the write chain (same pattern as `audit.SigningStore` in worker.go). It writes one JSON line per StoreEvent through its own `slog.JSONHandler`, separate from the operational logger.
- Config `auditLog: {enabled: false, output: stdout|file, path, maxSizeMB: 100, maxBackups: 10, maxAgeDays: 30, includeQuery: false}`. It is node-local (json:"-"). Rotation uses `gopkg.in/natefinch/lumberjack.v2` at a pinned version.
- Schema `warden.decision.v1`: ts, worker_id, agent_id, event_uid, decision, reason, protocol, domain, port, method, url_path (query stripped unless includeQuery), status, latency_ms, tool, provider, cost_usd, dlp_action, dlp_rule, data_classes, swapped_refs (placeholder names), compliance, judge_reason, user{sub,email,groups,sid,status}.
- Closed-set guarantee: lines are built from an explicit `decisionRecord` struct, never by marshaling Event, so new Event fields cannot leak. A reflection test pins the field list to the JSON Schema file.
- The CP admin audit lines (`warden.admin.v1`) use the same writer, so one shipper config covers both streams.

## Done when

With `auditLog.enabled: true, output: file`, each allowed or denied request produces exactly one schema-valid JSON line with user fields. Files rotate at the size cap, and a Vector config from the docs ships them.

### 1/4 · W-P1-JAUD-01

**Add internal/auditlog decision stream with stdout/file rotation**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#66](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/66)

Create new package `internal/auditlog` with `New(cfg, workerID, agentID) (*Writer, error)` and `NewStore(inner analytics.AnalyticsStore, w *Writer)`. The store builds a `decisionRecord` from each Event and writes it as a JSON line. If the write fails, the store increments `warden_auditlog_write_errors_total` and does not fail the request. Add the `auditLog` config block and wire the decorator in `internal/worker/worker.go` next to the SigningStore. Strip the URL query unless `includeQuery` is set.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] One request produces exactly one line, and allow and deny lines both carry the user fields when present
- [ ] Rotation at maxSizeMB keeps at most maxBackups files (test with a 1MB cap)
- [ ] A URL with `?token=abc` is logged without the query by default

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-VRFY-03`](identity-verification.md#35--w-p1-vrfy-03) Record user fields on events, receipts, logs and fleet ingest

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-JAUD-02`](audit-log-export.md#24--w-p1-jaud-02) Publish decision v1 JSON Schema with a closed-field test; [`W-P1-JAUD-03`](audit-log-export.md#34--w-p1-jaud-03) Route CP admin audit lines to the JSON audit writer

### 2/4 · W-P1-JAUD-02

**Publish decision v1 JSON Schema with a closed-field test**

Type **test** · Size **S** · Issue [#67](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/67)

Add `docs/schemas/warden.decision.v1.json` and `docs/schemas/warden.admin.v1.json` (JSON Schema 2020-12, `additionalProperties: false`). Add a test that marshals a fully populated `decisionRecord` and validates it against the schema, and a reflection test that fails when a field is added to `decisionRecord` without a schema update. Add a negative test asserting that no header names, body fields or secret values appear when an Event carries SecretRef and evidence.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] The schema test fails when a field is added to decisionRecord only
- [ ] No raw secret or request body appears in any emitted line in the negative test

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-JAUD-01`](audit-log-export.md#14--w-p1-jaud-01) Add internal/auditlog decision stream with stdout/file rotation

**Unblocks:** [`W-P1-JAUD-04`](audit-log-export.md#44--w-p1-jaud-04) Document SIEM shipping with Vector and Fluent Bit examples

### 3/4 · W-P1-JAUD-03

**Route CP admin audit lines to the JSON audit writer**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#68](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/68)

Allow the CP to configure the same `auditLog` block and pass the `auditlog.Writer` to the admin audit middleware, so `warden.admin.v1` lines go to the same sink. Worker decision lines and CP admin lines share the `schema` discriminator field.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] A CP policy save emits one warden.admin.v1 line to the configured file
- [ ] With auditLog disabled, the CP still logs admin_audit to its operational logger

**Depends on:** [`W-P1-JAUD-01`](audit-log-export.md#14--w-p1-jaud-01) Add internal/auditlog decision stream with stdout/file rotation; [`W-P1-AAUD-02`](admin-audit-log.md#23--w-p1-aaud-02) Record every CP mutation via audit middleware with state hashers

### 4/4 · W-P1-JAUD-04

**Document SIEM shipping with Vector and Fluent Bit examples**
